title: 第3章 凡骨试剑第4章 药铺断供
lines: 问剑碑前，人来得比沈照夜想得更快。
他从废剑冢走到前院，雨后的青石路还没干，消息已经传遍半座剑院。
废骨沈照夜没死。
废骨沈照夜碰了废剑冢的剑。
废骨沈照夜要当众重测剑骨。
问剑碑立在广场正中。
黑石三丈高，上面刻着历年入外院弟子的名字。名字旁有光痕，亮一寸是下品剑骨，亮三寸是中品，亮七寸以上，才有资格被宗门来人多看一眼。
沈照夜的名字不在上面。
他站在碑前三步外，右臂还在疼。
袖下几道红痕像活物一样沿着骨头游动。
韩松站在问剑碑旁，手里拿着两样东西。
一张新的除籍文书。
一张药铺欠账。
他把两张纸举起来。
“杂役弟子沈照夜，三年九测，剑骨无光。昨夜私入废剑冢，擅碰废剑。念其父曾在剑院留名，今日给他最后一次重测机会。”
四周安静下来。
“若问剑碑仍无光，立刻除籍，断剑入库，药债今日清算。”
药铺管事站在人群后，算盘抱在怀里。
沈照夜看见了。
也看见更后面的沈霜。
小姑娘披着旧灰衣，脸色白得像纸，靠在石柱旁，手里攥着那只断线旧荷包。
沈照夜的眼神停了一瞬。
沈霜没有喊他。
她只是隔着人群，轻轻摇了一下头。
别签。
沈照夜收回视线。
“可以测。”
人群里传来低笑。
“还真敢。”
“三年九测都是暗的，今日还能测出花？”
石阶上，一个身穿赤纹黑袍的青年缓步走来。
他一出现，周围弟子便自动让出路。
裴烈。
裴家少主，青岳剑院今年问剑前三的热门人选。
裴安低头：“烈哥。”
裴烈没看他，只扫了沈照夜一眼。
“就是他？”
韩松道：“一点小事，惊动裴少了。”
裴烈淡淡道：“裴家的名额被一个废骨拖了一夜，不算小事。”
这句话一出，广场更静。
content_en:
In front of the Wenjian Monument, people came faster than Shen Zhaoye thought.
He walked from the Abandoned Sword Tomb to the front yard. The bluestone road after the rain was not dry yet, and the news had spread throughout half of the sword courtyard.
The waste bones are still alive in Shen Zhaoye.
The Waste Bones Shen Zhaoye touched the sword of the Waste Sword Tomb.
Shen Zhaoye, a waste of bones, wants to retest the sword bones in public.
The Wenjian Monument stands in the middle of the square.
The black stone is three feet high and has the names of the disciples who have entered the outer courtyard over the years engraved on it. There are light marks next to the name. If the sword bone is one inch bright, it is a low-grade sword bone. If it is three inches bright, it is a middle-grade sword bone. Only if it is bright seven inches or more, it is qualified to be looked at by people from the sect.
Shen Zhaoye's name is not on it.
He stood three steps away from the monument, his right arm still hurting.
A few red marks under the sleeves were swimming along the bones like living creatures.
Han Song stood next to the Wenjian Monument, holding two things in his hands.
A new deregistration document.
A drug store owes a bill.
He held up the two pieces of paper.
"The handyman disciple Shen Zhaoye, after three years and nine tests, the sword bone was dull. Last night he secretly entered the abandoned sword grave and touched the used sword without permission. Remembering that his father had left his name in the sword academy, today I will give him the last chance to retest."
Everything fell silent.
"If the sword monument is still dull, the registration will be removed immediately, the broken sword will be put into the warehouse, and the medicine debt will be settled today."
The drug store manager stood behind the crowd, holding Abacus in his arms.
Shen Zhaoye saw it.
I also saw Shen Shuang further back.
The little girl was wrapped in old gray clothes, her face as white as paper, leaning against the stone pillar, holding the old broken-string purse in her hand.
Shen Zhaoye's eyes paused for a moment.
Shen Shuang didn't call him.
She just shook her head slightly across the crowd.
Don't sign.
Shen Zhaoye looked away.
"It can be measured."
There was a low laugh from the crowd.
"How dare you."
"It's been dark for three years and nine tests. Can you still detect flowers today?"
On the stone steps, a young man wearing a black robe with red stripes walked slowly.
As soon as he appeared, the surrounding disciples automatically gave way.
Pei Lie.
The young master of the Pei family, Qingyue Sword Academy's top three candidate for swordsmanship this year.
Pei An lowered his head: "Brother Lie."
Pei Lie didn't look at him, only glanced at Shen Zhaoye.
"That's him?"
Han Song said: "It's a little thing that disturbs Mr. Pei."
Pei Lie said calmly: "The Pei family's quota has been delayed all night by a useless person. It is not a small matter."
As soon as these words came out, the square became even quieter.
title_en: Chapter 3: Testing the Sword with Mortal Bones Chapter 4: The Medicine Shop Suspended
